ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side is labeled “nach Jettes Wurf”; the visible can numbers are 1, 9, 7, 8, 6, 4, 5, 9, as well as a 6 beside them. The right side is labeled “nach Willis Wurf”; the visible can numbers are 1, 9, 7, 3, 6, 6, 8, 2, 5, 3, 4. Reasoning: Each pyramid originally had the same structure and had 15 cans, and the score is found by summing the numbers on the cans that were hit. Jette hit 6 cans and got 25 points, so the total number sum of the whole pyramid is equal to the sum of the visible can numbers in the left picture plus 25. The sum of the visible numbers in the left picture is 1+9+7+8+6+4+5+9+6=55, so the total score of the whole pyramid is 55+25=80. Willi hit 4 cans, and the sum of the visible numbers in the right picture is 1+9+7+3+6+6+8+2+5+3+4=54. The total score of the identical pyramid is also 80, so the score of the cans hit by Willi is 80-54=26.

raw_record.question_text: Jette and Willi throw balls at two identically built pyramids each made up of 15 tins. Jette hits 6 tins and gets 25 points. Willi hits 4 tins. How many points does Willi get?

method.method_draft: Image: In the left panel labeled "nach Jettes Wurf," the visible tins are numbered 1, 9, 7, 8, 6, 4, 5, 9, and 6; in the right panel labeled "nach Willis Wurf," the visible tins are numbered 1, 9, 7, 3, 6, 6, 8, 2, 5, 3, and 4. Text: Jette hits 6 tins and gets 25 points, and Willi hits 4 tins. Rule/bridge: the score is the sum of the hit tins, so each pyramid has one fixed total. Jette's visible tins sum to 55, so the full pyramid totals 80; Willi's visible tins sum to 54, so his hit tins score 80 - 54 = 26.

推理：每个金字塔原本结构相同、都有 15 个罐头，得分按被击中的罐头数字求和。Jette 击中 6 个罐头得 25 分，因此整座金字塔的总数字和等于左图可见罐头数字和加 25。左图可见数字和为 1+9+7+8+6+4+5+9+6=55，所以整座金字塔总分为 55+25=80。Willi 击中 4 个罐头，右图可见数字和为 1+9+7+3+6+6+8+2+5+3+4=54。相同金字塔总分也是 80，所以 Willi 击中的罐头分数为 80-54=26。
